title: 2020年12月大学英语四级真题（第2套）
paperTitle: 2020年12月大学英语四级真题（第2套）
prompt: For this part , you are allowed 30 minutes to write an essay on the topic Changes in the way of Transportation. You should write at least 120 words but no more than 180 words.
reference: How people travel has changed dramatically over the past few decades. In the past, most of my grandparents' generation walked or rode bicycles to work, and a trip to another city took a whole day by slow train. Nowadays, the picture looks completely different. The most obvious change lies in the variety and speed of transport. Today we can take the subway across a huge city in minutes, reach a distant province by high-speed rail in a few hours, or simply open an app to call a car or unlock a shared bike. Two forces drive this shift. Technological progress makes fast and smart travel possible, while rising incomes and growing environmental concerns push people toward high-speed rail and new-energy vehicles. In my view, these changes have made our lives far more convenient and our cities greener. As technology keeps advancing, I firmly believe transportation will become even faster, cleaner and smarter in the years to come.
keyPoints: 总起＋今昔画面点题。首句 How people travel has changed dramatically 直接点出『变 化』主线（用了『点出变化主线』句架）；随后 In the past ... walked or rode bicycles 与 Nowadays, the picture looks completely different 形成今昔对比（『今昔对照句架』），落实了 outline 第一段 『点题＋今昔对比开篇』的功能。

并列铺陈＋两股动力。Today we can take the subway ..., reach a distant province ..., or simply open an app 用并列句把多样出行铺开（『并列铺陈现象』句架）；Two forces drive this shift ... while ... 完成归因（『归因连接』句架），实现了第二段『展开变化＋分析动力』的功能，把现象写成 了议论。

表态＋未来展望收束。In my view, these changes have made our lives far more convenient 明确表态（『亮明态度』句架）；As technology keeps advancing, I firmly believe transportation will become even faster 给出未来判断（『未来展望』句架），完成第三段『评价意义 ＋展望未来』的收束。
